title: The Greatest Miracle
verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
observation: When you think about it, the first verse is easily the greatest in the entire Bible. If God can create the heavens and the earth, then anything else is possible. When we also realize that the book of Genesis was written to the recently liberated people of Israel, we realize that God was correcting any false theology they had picked up in the nation of Egypt. Creation was not a group effort. Creation was by the one and only sovereign God. That reminds us that our King reigns supreme, He is above all, and nothing is impossible with Him.
application: Think about the greatness of God. Everything you see has been created by God.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for calling us Your special creation out of all the wonders You have made.
